clips.title: The story
paras: The Scarlet Basilica is a grand cathedral standing at the heart of Tyr's Hand in the Eastern Plaguelands. It serves as the high seat of spiritual and military authority for the Scarlet Crusade in the east. Overseen by Crusader Lord Valdelmar, its halls represent the zealots' unyielding bastion against the Scourge.

Rising prominently over the fortified enclave of Tyr's Hand, the Scarlet Basilica acts as the central cathedral and command hub for the Scarlet Crusade's operations in the Eastern Plaguelands. While the Scarlet Monastery far to the west in Tirisfal Glades serves as the order's spiritual heart, this basilica anchors their surviving territorial stronghold against the blighted horrors of Lordaeron. Guarded fiercely by elite crusaders, the cathedral houses Crusader Lord Valdelmar, who directs the local defense and zealously purges any outsiders who dare approach.
